requirements.summary: Increase SiteHeader height and enlarge brand logo while keeping current responsive layout and smooth-scroll/mobile menu behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile, the header bar is visibly taller than the current h-20 implementation and does not clip content.
On md+ breakpoints, the header bar is visibly taller than the current md:h-24 implementation and does not clip content.
The header logo image renders larger than the current h-[44px] (mobile) and md:h-[53px] (md+) values, without changing the underlying image file path.
Desktop navigation and CTA remain aligned and do not wrap/collide with the logo/brand text at typical viewport widths (e.g., 1024px+).
Mobile menu open/close behavior and smooth-scroll behavior continue to work correctly after the header size change (scroll offset accounts for the new header height).

file_operations.description: Increase header bar vertical sizing (mobile and md+) and enlarge the existing header logo via Tailwind classes (do not change BRAND_ASSETS.logo.header). Prefer min-height + padding adjustments to avoid clipping. Ensure desktop nav/CTA alignment remains stable at 1024px+ widths and that mobile menu toggling still closes before invoking scrollToSection. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm smooth-scroll offset remains correct after header height changes by continuing to derive offset from runtime header height; adjust buffer/measurement timing only if needed to prevent under/over-scrolling when mobile menu closes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Provide a documented, repeatable production preflight + deploy procedure, with runnable preflight checks for TypeScript compilation and required static assets.
acceptanceCriteria: A developer can follow frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md to run production preflight checks and perform a production deployment to the Internet Computer.
Running the production preflight runner fails with a non-zero exit code if TypeScript compilation fails or required static assets are missing, and succeeds (exit code 0) when all checks pass.

DEPLOYMENT.md includes a post-deployment verification checklist that covers at least: header rendering across breakpoints, hero background rendering, navigation scroll offset correctness, and no missing asset 404s in production.

file_operations.description: Complete and expand the deployment guide into a clear, repeatable procedure: prerequisites (dfx, Node), how to run the production preflight runner, build steps, and Internet Computer deployment steps aligned with the repository’s ICP CLI setup. Include a post-deployment verification checklist covering: header sizing across breakpoints, hero background rendering, navigation scroll offset correctness, and checking for missing assets/404s. Reference that the repo uses the github-export-icp-cli template to support ICP deployment workflow; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden the preflight runner to be reliably repeatable from a developer machine (clearer output, consistent working directory expectations, and guaranteed non-zero exit when checks fail). Keep checks limited to TypeScript compilation and required static asset verification per requirements.

Ensure required static asset verification matches current app asset usage (header logo, generated logos, hero background) and produces actionable error output with non-zero exit on missing files. Keep scope strictly to verification (no asset generation or uploads).
